pageHero.title: Send a clear request.
pageHero.body: Use this page to route project, content, partnership, or support requests to the right team.

slides.caption: Send a concise request through the contact form.
Keep the request clear so the right team can respond.

contactSection.title: Submit one focused request.
contactSection.body: Share only the information needed to understand and route your request.

contactSection.responseTime: To provide a better service experience, we are refining our contact and customer support workflow. During this transition, replies, qualification, and follow-up may take longer than usual.

fieldCopy.messagePlaceholder: Share the context, goal, and any relevant timing.

legalNotice.title: Before you send
legalNotice.body: By submitting this form, you confirm that the information may be used to review, categorize, and respond to your request. Do not include passwords, payment credentials, verification codes, full identity documents, medical records, or unrelated sensitive information.
legalNotice.acceptance: Selecting Send request means you have read and accept the applicable notices above.

contactSection.successBody: Thank you. We will review your request by email.
contactSection.errorTitle: The message could not be sent.
contactSection.disabledBody: The form is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

blocks.title: A lightweight email handoff.
blocks.body: This contact page is designed for low-volume business inquiries. It does not create a custom support database or customer account.
items: No message body is stored in Sanity, Shopify, coordinator storage, KV, D1, or R2
Turnstile and rate limits protect the recipient mailbox
The public page uses the form only and does not expose a direct mailto link
